1.sahih_international: By the sky and the night comer -
1.pickthall: By the heaven and the Morning Star
1.yusuf_ali: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-
1.shakir: I swear by the heaven and the comer by night;
1.mohsin_khan: By the heaven, and At-Tariq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star);

2.sahih_international: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
2.pickthall: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
2.yusuf_ali: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
2.shakir: And what will make you know what the comer by night is?
2.muhammad_sarwar: Do you know what al-tariq is?
2.mohsin_khan: And what will make you to know what At-Tariq (night-comer) is?
2.arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the night-star?

3.yusuf_ali: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-
3.mohsin_khan: (It is) the star of piercing brightness;

4.sahih_international: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
4.pickthall: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
4.yusuf_ali: There is no soul but has a protector over it.
4.shakir: There is not a soul but over it is a keeper.
4.muhammad_sarwar: There is no soul which is not guarded (by the two angels who record all of its deeds).
4.mohsin_khan: There is no human being but has a protector over him (or her) (i.e. angels incharge of each human being guarding him, writing his good and bad deeds, etc.)
4.arberry: Over every soul there is a watcher.

5.sahih_international: So let man observe from what he was created.
5.pickthall: So let man consider from what he is created.
5.yusuf_ali: Now let man but think from what he is created!
5.shakir: So let man consider of what he is created:
5.muhammad_sarwar: Let the human being reflect that from what he has been created.
5.mohsin_khan: So let man see from what he is created!
5.arberry: So let man consider of what he was created;

6.sahih_international: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
6.pickthall: He is created from a gushing fluid
6.yusuf_ali: He is created from a drop emitted-
6.shakir: He is created of water pouring forth,
6.muhammad_sarwar: He has been created from an ejected drop of fluid
6.mohsin_khan: He is created from a water gushing forth.
6.arberry: he was created of gushing water

7.sahih_international: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
7.pickthall: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
7.yusuf_ali: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
7.shakir: Coming from between the back and the ribs.
7.muhammad_sarwar: which comes out of the loins and ribs.
7.mohsin_khan: Proceeding from between the back-bone and the ribs,
7.arberry: issuing between the loins and the breast-bones.

8.sahih_international: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
8.pickthall: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
8.yusuf_ali: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!
8.shakir: Most surely He is able to return him (to life).
8.muhammad_sarwar: God has all power to resurrect him.
8.mohsin_khan: Verily, (Allah) is Able to bring him back (to life)!
8.arberry: Surely He is able to bring him back

9.sahih_international: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
9.pickthall: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
9.yusuf_ali: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,
9.shakir: On the day when hidden things shall be made manifest,
9.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when all secrets will be made public,
9.mohsin_khan: The Day when all the secrets (deeds, prayers, fasting, etc.) will be examined (as to their truth).
9.arberry: upon the day when the secrets are tried,

10.sahih_international: Then man will have no power or any helper.
10.pickthall: Then will he have no might nor any helper.
10.yusuf_ali: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.
10.shakir: He shall have neither strength nor helper.
10.muhammad_sarwar: he will have no power, nor anyone to help him.
10.mohsin_khan: Then will (man) have no power, nor any helper.
10.arberry: and he shall have no strength, no helper.

11.pickthall: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
11.yusuf_ali: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),
11.shakir: I swear by the raingiving heavens,
11.mohsin_khan: By the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again.
11.arberry: By heaven of the returning rain,

12.sahih_international: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
12.pickthall: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
12.yusuf_ali: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-
12.mohsin_khan: And the earth which splits (with the growth of trees and plants),

13.sahih_international: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
13.pickthall: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,
13.yusuf_ali: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):
13.shakir: Most surely it is a decisive word,
13.muhammad_sarwar: the Quran is the final word,
13.mohsin_khan: Verily! This (the Quran) is the Word that separates (the truth from falsehood, and commands strict legal laws for mankind to cut the roots of evil).
13.arberry: surely it is a decisive word;

14.yusuf_ali: It is not a thing for amusement.
14.muhammad_sarwar: and it is certainly not a jest.
14.mohsin_khan: And it is not a thing for amusement.

15.sahih_international: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
15.pickthall: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
15.yusuf_ali: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,
15.shakir: Surely they will make a scheme,
15.mohsin_khan: Verily, they are but plotting a plot (against you O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)).

16.sahih_international: But I am planning a plan.
16.pickthall: And I plot a plot (against them).
16.yusuf_ali: And I am planning a scheme.
16.shakir: And I (too) will make a scheme.
16.muhammad_sarwar: but I too plan against them.
16.mohsin_khan: And I (too) am planning a plan.

17.sahih_international: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
17.pickthall: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
17.yusuf_ali: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
17.shakir: So grant the unbelievers a respite: let them alone for a while.
17.muhammad_sarwar: Give respite to the disbelievers and leave them alone for a while.
17.mohsin_khan: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal you gently with them for a while.
17.arberry: So respite the unbelievers; delay with them awhile.
